notes.title: Steam Game Festival Demo & Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33230365/717740c4302b8684a6587f38d67af78789f64f86.gif[/img]

[h2]Try Quench for free this week![/h2]

Looking for a game to play with your kids? Wanted to play Quench at a booth and missed out?

This week only, as part of the Steam Game Festival, you can play the first 4 levels of Quench at home by trying out our limited-time demo! (It's just like a booth, but no one's watching except your pets!)

[h2]Liked the demo? The full game is 50% off![/h2]

If you loved having magical weather powers and helping your elephant friends, we're offering a 50% discount for the full game until March 23!

Sunday, March 22 is World Water Day, and we're supporting communities in need of clean water by donating $1 from every sale to [url=https://www.charitywater.org/]charity : water[/url]. 

[h3]About Quench[/h3]

Quench is a story-driven puzzle game set in a colourful, lo-fi world. Become shepherd, an avatar of nature, and guide herds of animals on their difficult journey. Help Shaman, the young Elephant leader, convince the other animal tribes to join her.

Quench is rated E for everyone.

notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Clearer path selection glyphs on mouse and keyboard (Z and X for next and previous paths instead of arrow keys, which move the camera)
[*] Added context glyph hint for moving the camera during weather placement mode
[*] Fixed an issue with inconsistent controller detection in How To Play overlays
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Volume now lowers to 20% when the game is paused
[*] Game volume is muted while application is minimized
[/list]

[b]Gameplay/Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the credits
[*] Hid/disabled the cursor in scenes that don't require it if inactive for 3s
[*] Fixed an issue with firefly traps in levels 15 and 24
[*] Fixed an issue with player inappropriately losing the competition in level 13
[/list]

[b]Upcoming changes (not in this version)[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding player options for remapping, vsync, camera speed, assist modes
[*] General performance improvements
[/list]

Did you find a bug or want to request a feature? Head over to our Discord #support channel to report it! --> [url=http://discord.io/quench-support]http://discord.io/quench-support[/url]

notes.title: Launch Date Announced + charity: water Collaboration!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We're thrilled to announce that Quench is coming to all platforms on August 7th![/b]
[/h1]

[url=https://youtu.be/1IoJIgAPbZw]Check out our brand-new trailer here![/url]

[h1]We're collaborating with charity: water![/h1]

We are proud to announce that $1 from all sales in the month of August will be donated to charity: water, an international non-for-profit organization whose mission is to bring clean and safe drinking water to people in developing countries. Up to $10,000 will be raised to fund a water project for a community in need, with real-time progress reported back to all players. We're super excited to see what we can all make happen together.

If you haven't already, now is a great time to wishlist us, so you'll get the news the moment Quench comes out.
